note: Taliaferro County (GA) has a zoning ordinance (A-1, R-1 to R-3, C-1, M-1 districts) on Municode, and its GIS is a Schneider Beacon/qPublic viewer (parcel map). No public ArcGIS REST, WFS or downloadable service of zoning district polygons was found in ArcGIS search or web search; the official zoning map appears only as an overlay in the viewer or as PDF/maps. Neither the county nor Crawfordville or Sharon publishes a queryable zoning layer that I could locate.
